svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: commits
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing shows lifetime aggregate weekly commits. Totals: 8,057 GitHub-credited commits and 7,133 authored commits. The 924-commit gap contains merges and deploys and is drawn as the band between the total boundary and authored line. 201 active weeks. COMMITS / WEEK · LOG1P. The complete lifetime record covers 470 weekly buckets through the last completed day.
